subject: Carely MAP: success yardstick, exit triggers & acceptance smoke plan
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@carely.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Carely MAP: success yardstick, exit triggers & acceptance smoke plan

Hi Patricia —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I attached a one-sheet MAP draft and an acceptance-test matrix to make the evaluation gating explicit. High-level ask: confirm these success criteria and exit gates so we can lock the test harness and kickoff integration next week.

Proposed evaluation scope (4 weeks):
- Objective: validate Redwood inference for Carely workflows (clinical summarization + triage suggestion).
- Week 0 (kickoff & infra): credentials, initial connectivity, dataset ingestion verification.
- Week 1 (smoke + functional): run curated prompt set, confirm end-to-end flows against labeled examples.
- Week 2 (performance + load): throughput and P95 latency tests; cache behavior; failure-mode checks.
- Week 3 (quality + signoff): final concordance tests with Carely SMEs, SOC2 evidence review, executive review and go/no-go.

Draft success criteria (please confirm or edit):
- Latency: P95 generation latency < 350ms for target request size (under baseline load).
- Throughput: sustained 50 req/s for the clinical summarization route with <2% error rate.
- Quality: 95% intent/concordance on the labeled 500-case test set (Carely-provided labels).
- Hallucination tolerance: <1% high-risk hallucinations on the safety probe set (definitions in attached matrix).
- Cost signal: evaluate unit cost during the run; target for post-eval negotiations but will capture as metric.
- Compliance: SOC2 artifact access and integration checklist completed before signoff.

Exit gates / acceptance tests (examples):
- Functional smoke: pass >= 95% of L1 flows in the scripted 100-case demo (run by Carely SME).
- Regression tests: no >2% drop vs baseline for intent detection across 5 critical intents.
- Performance: 1-minute ramp to 60 RPS with P95 < 500ms and <1% error.
- Security/compliance: KMS integration verified; audit-log sampling validated.

Attachments: carely_map_draft_v2.xlsx (MAP + timeline), acceptance_test_matrix.csv (detailed tests & owners).

If these look reasonable, can we schedule a 30-minute kickoff on June 22 at 10:00 AM PT? If you need any of the acceptance checks tightened or a cost target added to the MAP, call that out and we’ll incorporate it.

Thanks —
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: 415-555-0128

From: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@carely.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Carely MAP: success yardstick, exit triggers & acceptance smoke plan

Dylan — thanks for the clear draft. A few clarifying requests from our side before we confirm: 

1) Hallucination metric — can you define what counts as a "high-risk hallucination" in the matrix? We need an operational definition so our SMEs label consistently.
2) Model variant — which model/version will you run for the evaluation? We need a pinned model for our QA.
3) Cost target — we'd like a cost-per-1k-token goal surfaced in the MAP; that matters for procurement.
4) Timeline — is there flexibility to start a week earlier if the team can do an accelerated integration?

Procurement will also attach our standard terms (see attached procurement_terms.pdf). We will need SOC2 evidence and a brief KMS checklist before final signoff.

Happy to do the June 22 kickoff, but can you confirm the model/version and add an explicit cost metric in the acceptance matrix?

Best,
Patricia
Head of Product Ops | Carely Health
pat.gomez@carely.com

>

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Patricia Gomez <pat.gomez@carely.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-19T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Carely MAP: success yardstick, exit triggers & acceptance smoke plan

Patricia — thanks for the questions. I took a pass on the MAP and updated the acceptance matrix (attached) to be explicit on model, metrics, and the exact tests we will run. Summary of changes / answers to your items: 

1) Model variant
- Primary eval model: rw-innova-13B-quant (quantized 13B build verified on our Dedicated fleet).
- Latency fallback: rw-innova-7B-8bit for sub-300ms latency experiments if needed (we'll document any quality delta).

2) Hallucination definition
- "High-risk hallucination" = generated assertion that is falsifiable against provided EHR sections and that could materially change triage outcome (examples & labeling rules in acceptance_test_matrix.csv).
- We'll run an adjudication pass with Carely SMEs on any flagged cases (adjudicator = Carely SME + Redwood reviewer).

3) Cost signal
- We'll capture cost-per-1k-tokens during the run and include a target for procurement conversations. Suggested initial target for evaluation discussion: <$0.06 per 1k inference tokens (we'll refine after load profile run).

4) Timeline adjustments
- We can accelerate integration by one week if Carely can provide S3 dataset + API credentials by EOD June 19. Revised kickoff if accelerated: June 21 (kickoff) -> Week 1 smoke on June 22. If not, original June 22 kickoff stands.

Acceptance tests (concrete):
- Functional smoke: 100-case scripted demo (95% pass) run in staging with Carely SME on-site (remote).
- Labeled concordance: 500-case labeled set, blind eval, >=95% on intents and triage-label agreement.
- Performance stress: 1-minute linear ramp to 120 RPS; P95 < 500ms and error rate <2%.
- Security/compliance: KMS rotate-test + sample audit log retrieval.

Attachments: acceptance_test_matrix.csv (updated), carely_map_draft_v2.xlsx (timeline revised).

If you confirm the dataset delivery timeline, we will lock the accelerated kickoff and provision the test harness.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Carely MAP: success yardstick, exit triggers & acceptance smoke plan

Hi Dylan and Ben —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the clarified matrix, Ben. Carely is aligned with the definitions and tests you proposed. A few operational notes from our side before kickoff: 

- Dataset & SMEs: we'll deliver the labeled 500-case set and a 100-case smoke demo by close of business June 21. SMEs for adjudication: Patricia Gomez (me) and Samir Iqbal <samir.iqbal@carely.com>.
- Procurement: attached procurement_terms.pdf with a couple of redlines; procurement@carely.com is on copy for legal/PO coordination.
- SOC2 & KMS: we'll need the SOC2 report access and a KMS integration checklist completed during Week 0. Please add a single-line item in the MAP that this is gating for signoff.
- Cost: the <$0.06/1k-token suggested is fine for evaluation but will be revisited in commercial terms.

We are available to kickoff June 22 at 10:00 AM PT — please send a calendar invite and a short agenda (30 min): 1) connectivity check, 2) acceptance matrix review, 3) SME roles & dataset handoff, 4) timeline & next steps.

Approval: Carely gives tentative go for the MAP and acceptance tests pending SOC2 access + dataset delivery.

Thanks,
Patricia
Head of Product Ops | Carely Health
pat.gomez@carely.com
